package survival

// 四种物资按 wood / ore / food / medkit 排列，只有服务器封存的撤离清单可兑换永久资产。
type Inventory [4]int

func (v Inventory) Count() int {
	n := 0
	for _, x := range v {
		n += x
	}
	return n
}
func (v Inventory) Valid() bool {
	for _, x := range v {
		if x < 0 || x > 1000 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type Command struct {
	Seq, Epoch uint64
	Kind       string
	A, B       int
}
type Receipt struct {
	Command   Command
	Inventory Inventory
	Status    string
	At        int64
}
type Seat struct {
	PlayerID                     int64
	Epoch                        uint64
	Connected, Joined, Claimed   bool
	Status                       string
	Pos, HP                      int
	Inventory, Extracted         Inventory
	CraftAt, ExtractAt, NextMove int64
	Receipts                     []Receipt
}
type Drop struct {
	Pos       int
	Inventory Inventory
}
type State struct {
	Schema                            int
	Rules                             Rules
	Phase                             string
	Seats                             [Seats]Seat
	Nodes                             [3]int
	Drops                             [Seats]Drop
	Crafted, UsedMedkits              int
	LastAt, EndAt, HazardAt, Deadline int64
}
type PublicSeat struct {
	PlayerID  int64
	Status    string
	Pos, HP   int
	Connected bool
}
type SeatView struct {
	Epoch, NextSeq       uint64
	Inventory, Extracted Inventory
	CraftAt, ExtractAt   int64
	Claimed              bool
}
type View struct {
	Phase, ConfigHash       string
	LastAt, EndAt, Deadline int64
	Nodes                   [3]int
	Drops                   [Seats]Drop
	Players                 [Seats]PublicSeat
	Self                    SeatView
}

func (s State) Index(id int64) int {
	for i, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.PlayerID == id {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}
func (s State) View(id int64) (View, error) {
	i := s.Index(id)
	if i < 0 {
		return View{}, ErrRule
	}
	v := View{Phase: s.Phase, ConfigHash: s.Rules.Hash(), LastAt: s.LastAt, EndAt: s.EndAt, Deadline: s.Deadline, Nodes: s.Nodes, Drops: s.Drops}
	for j, p := range s.Seats {
		v.Players[j] = PublicSeat{p.PlayerID, p.Status, p.Pos, p.HP, p.Connected}
	}
	p := s.Seats[i]
	v.Self = SeatView{p.Epoch, uint64(len(p.Receipts) + 1), p.Inventory, p.Extracted, p.CraftAt, p.ExtractAt, p.Claimed}
	return v, nil
}
func New(ids [Seats]int64, r Rules, now int64) (State, error) {
	s := State{Schema: 1, Rules: r, Phase: "running", Nodes: r.Nodes, LastAt: now, EndAt: now + r.RaidMillis, HazardAt: now + r.HazardMillis}
	if r.Validate() != nil || now <= 0 || s.EndAt >= MaxTime {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	for i, id := range ids {
		if id <= 0 {
			return State{}, ErrRule
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if ids[j] == id {
				return State{}, ErrRule
			}
		}
		s.Seats[i] = Seat{PlayerID: id, Epoch: 1, Connected: true, Status: "pending"}
	}
	s.schedule()
	return s, s.Validate()
}
func (s State) Encode() string { return encode(s) }
func Decode(raw string) (State, error) {
	var s State
	if e := strictJSON(raw, &s); e != nil {
		return s, e
	}
	return s, s.Validate()
}
func (s State) next() int64 {
	if s.Phase == "done" {
		return 0
	}
	d := min(s.EndAt, s.HazardAt)
	for _, p := range s.Seats {
		for _, at := range []int64{p.CraftAt, p.ExtractAt} {
			if at > 0 {
				d = min(d, at)
			}
		}
	}
	return d
}
func (s *State) schedule() {
	active := false
	for _, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.Status == "alive" || p.Status == "pending" {
			active = true
		}
	}
	if !active {
		s.Phase = "done"
	}
	s.Deadline = s.next()
}
func (p Seat) Load() int {
	n := p.Inventory.Count()
	if p.CraftAt != 0 {
		n += 3
	}
	return n
}
func (s State) Validate() error {
	if s.Schema != 1 || s.Rules.Validate() != nil || (s.Phase != "running" && s.Phase != "done") || s.LastAt <= 0 || s.LastAt >= MaxTime || s.EndAt <= 0 || s.EndAt >= MaxTime || s.HazardAt <= 0 || s.HazardAt >= MaxTime || s.Deadline != s.next() || s.Crafted < 0 || s.Crafted > 1000 || s.UsedMedkits < 0 || s.UsedMedkits > s.Crafted {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if s.Phase == "running" && (s.EndAt <= s.LastAt || s.HazardAt <= s.LastAt || s.Deadline <= s.LastAt) {
		return ErrRule
	}
	total := Inventory{s.Nodes[0], s.Nodes[1], s.Nodes[2], 0}
	joined := 0
	active := false
	for k, n := range s.Nodes {
		if n < 0 || n > s.Rules.Nodes[k] {
			return ErrRule
		}
	}
	for i, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.PlayerID <= 0 || s.Index(p.PlayerID) != i || p.Epoch == 0 || p.Pos < 0 || p.Pos > 3 || p.HP < 0 || p.HP > s.Rules.HP || !p.Inventory.Valid() || !p.Extracted.Valid() || p.Load() > s.Rules.Capacity || p.Extracted.Count() > s.Rules.Capacity || len(p.Receipts) > LedgerLimit || p.NextMove < 0 || p.NextMove >= MaxTime {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if p.Joined {
			joined++
		}
		switch p.Status {
		case "pending":
			active = true
			if p.Joined || p.HP != 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
		case "alive":
			active = true
			if !p.Joined || p.HP == 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
		case "dead":
			if !p.Joined || p.HP != 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
		case "extracted":
			if !p.Joined || p.HP == 0 || p.Pos != 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
		case "missed":
			if p.Joined || p.HP != 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
		default:
			return ErrRule
		}
		if p.Status != "alive" && (p.Inventory.Count() != 0 || p.CraftAt != 0 || p.ExtractAt != 0) {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if p.Status != "extracted" && p.Extracted.Count() != 0 {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if p.Claimed && (p.Status != "extracted" && p.Status != "dead") {
			return ErrRule
		}
		for _, at := range []int64{p.CraftAt, p.ExtractAt} {
			if at != 0 && (at <= s.LastAt || at >= s.EndAt) {
				return ErrRule
			}
		}
		if p.ExtractAt != 0 && (p.Pos != 0 || p.CraftAt != 0) {
			return ErrRule
		}
		for j, r := range p.Receipts {
			if r.Command.Seq != uint64(j+1) || r.Command.Epoch == 0 || r.Command.Epoch > p.Epoch || r.At <= 0 || r.At > s.LastAt {
				return ErrRule
			}
		}
		d := s.Drops[i]
		if d.Pos < 0 || d.Pos > 3 || !d.Inventory.Valid() || (p.Status != "dead" && d.Inventory.Count() != 0) {
			return ErrRule
		}
		for k := range total {
			total[k] += p.Inventory[k] + p.Extracted[k] + d.Inventory[k]
		}
		if p.CraftAt != 0 {
			total[0] += 2
			total[2]++
		}
	}
	if (s.Phase == "done") == active {
		return ErrRule
	}
	// 制作的原料与已使用药剂也入账，检查整个局的物资守恒，而不只检查余额非负。
	total[0] += 2 * s.Crafted
	total[2] += s.Crafted
	total[3] += s.UsedMedkits
	if total[0] != s.Rules.Nodes[0]+2*joined || total[1] != s.Rules.Nodes[1] || total[2] != s.Rules.Nodes[2]+joined || total[3] != s.Crafted {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func (s State) Reward(i int) int64 {
	if s.Seats[i].Status != "extracted" {
		return 0
	}
	n := int64(0)
	for k, v := range s.Seats[i].Extracted {
		n += int64(v * s.Rules.Prices[k])
	}
	return n
}
